mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate relative to its 12-month moving average compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below its 12-month moving average, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in unemployment rate above 4.0% signals economic weakness and reduced consumer spending, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%), the Federal Reserve maintains restrictive policy that increases discount rates and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 5.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 (2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction and reduced economic output, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 100.0, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 > 0.5% q/q) indicates robust economic expansion, supporting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through elevated corporate earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 0.5% q/q, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in employment growth (PAYEMS) and rising unemployment (UNRATE) signal labor market deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced consumer spending power.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises from prior month, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, increasing borrowing costs and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
